fields.description: The Serene is a Sobha Central apartment tower above a landscaped podium on Sheikh Zayed Road. Its original one- and two-bedroom offering is complemented by separately documented three-bedroom layouts with service accommodation.

overview: The podium park and shared facilities give the tower a community setting, while apartment plans vary by level. The reviewed examples separate indoor suite area from balcony area, making them more useful for comparison than an undifferentiated project average.
research.locationNote: At Sobha Central along Sheikh Zayed Road. Confirm the precise tower approach, transport access and outlook; proposed community links are not a guarantee of a fixed walking or driving time.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.86m subject to inventory. The original factsheet lists launch guides of AED 1.40m for one bedroom and AED 2.47m for two. These are different dated selections, not proof of current stock or universal price changes.
research.paymentNote: The original branded factsheet gives 20% booking, four 10% payments at 12, 24, 36 and 42 months from booking, then 40% on completion. Confirm that calendar against the actual booking date, revised completion programme and current offer.
research.handoverNote: The official brochure and branded factsheet print December 2029. A broker separately attributes June 2030 to the wider regulatory project record; that claim was not independently verified. Keep the developer estimate distinct and obtain the selected unit’s contractual date.
